name: concentus-website
description: The website and its serverless functions. Deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace member: these dependencies exist for Vercel's function runtime, which installs them at deploy time — the repo's own install and CI never need them.

scripts.//test: Explicit file paths, not a glob or a directory: node --test on a bare directory is unreliable on Windows Node, and this list is exactly what CI runs.
scripts.test: node --test api/_lib/license-format.test.mjs api/_lib/pricing.test.mjs api/_lib/stripe.test.mjs api/license.test.mjs api/checkout.test.mjs api/stripe-webhook.test.mjs
